mechanism: A single violent displacement pulse (5.21 to 6.36, 07-31 to 08-03) arrived on a broken conductor: URF flatlined at 0.000 with three channel deaths on the pulse day itself, so the spike was carried by damage, not structure. The field never re-knitted under the elevated price — a second full dead-channel event with four deaths hit 08-13, and stability has sagged monotonically since (0.92 down to 0.749) while price grinds flat on the pulse shelf with zero ignitions all month. The pulse's stored energy is spent and the substrate beneath keeps failing, so the displacement should relax back toward the pre-pulse level.
